title: Standing Tall (Yima Nkqo)
brief_summary: The investigators propose the Standing Tall study, a prospective randomised study of strategy to optimize community-based ART initiation in South Africa. Investigators will work closely with community members to integrate community-based ART. One hundred participants will be enrolled and followed for a total of up to 6 months. Those in the intervention arm will be provided with the ST intervention which includes a behavioral component and access to ART. The intervention will be linked to a clinic through a "Nurse Initiated Management of ART."
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Complete an assessment of understanding
* Provide informed consent
* Are between ages 18-24
* Present to Tutu Tester vans in Cape Town OR East London DTHF clinics (Duncan Village Day Hospital, Empilweni Gompo Health Centre, Gompo C Clinic) and test HIV+
* Are ART-naïve
* Are English or isiXhosa speakers
* Reside in the Cape Town or East London metro area

Exclusion Criteria:

* Are pregnant (must be referred to antenatal clinic if living with HIV)
* Test positive for tuberculosis (must be referred to clinic for TB treatment prior to ART initiation)
* Are unable to understand the process of informed consent
